design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — member_equity_patronage task 1 (Wendell Pokorny, Class H redemption request).

0. DRAW AND SCOPE. draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 5, 5]}. Problems and counts: root equity_ext_preferred_redemption_request (5, owner=user), equity_ext_preferred_redemption_payment (6), equity_ext_preferred_dividend_reinvestment (4), equity_ext_preferred_holding_excess_refund (5). Task 0 occupies the quarter-limit refund, the dividend reversal and the purchase room with their three tools; the scopes are disjoint and cover all seven policies (check_extended final run). Revision record: this chain began as task 0 (request <- payment <- dividend); the holding-ceiling refund was added beneath the dividend and the tree moved to task 1 to meet the draws (see task 0, section 0); the request's original ceiling factor was replaced by an additive pacing reserve because a binding ceiling masked the dividend-seasoning factor (its baseline gave the same capped figure); the payment gained the size reduction and the delay addition to reach six factors.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. The member asks only to 'redeem as much of your Class H preferred stock as the association's rules allow while keeping the preferred account open'. Before that request can be sized and registered, the records demand three corrections in a strict chain: the 2026-05-18 purchase took the shares counted toward the ceiling above the holding maximum (refund 7,500.00); the second-quarter dividend paid 2026-07-15 is unbooked and must be figured on the corrected shares (12,136.18); the approved June redemption request for 600,000.00 is past its notice and unpaid and must be paid up to the quarter's redemption allowance (527,327.95). Only then is the request (360,128.03) computed and handed to the member. Each step is a multi-factor calculation over the ledger and other products (farm real estate principal and installment, operating commitment, equipment installment as a near-miss).

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Edges (all state form, value_input): request -> payment, gate rq_shares: 'A new preferred redemption request is not registered until no approved redemption on the holding whose notice period has run remains unpaid.' (negated direction); payment -> dividend, gate rp_base: 'The amount paid on an approved redemption is fixed only after the holding carries the reinvested dividend for every quarter whose dividend payment date has passed.'; dividend -> ceiling refund, gate div_basis: 'The quarterly preferred dividend is fixed only after the holding carries a cancellation entry for every share it held above the largest balance a member may hold.' Each has an ordering connective, waits on a record-visible state (an unpaid approved request with the holding still retirement_requested; a reinvested entry per passed payment date; a subscription-cancelled entry for the excess), names no tool, id or code token. Exactly one write produces each state: the payment tool, the dividend booking tool, the holding-ceiling refund tool. Unresolved at frozen_time 2026-07-22: request row approved 2026-06-03 with holding status retirement_requested; latest reinvested entry dated 2026-04-15; counted shares 1,030,000.00 above the ceiling 1,022,500.00 with no cancellation entry. Order: refund (step 9) -> dividend (11) -> payment (13) -> request (15); a chain, no parallel edges. Deletion sensitivity (real-tool replay): skip refund -> dividend 12,179.13, payment 529,967.99, request 363,415.65; skip dividend -> payment 523,080.29, request 203,028.36; skip payment -> request 945,776.89. The customer's own write is the written redemption request (owner=user).

3. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Ceiling refund (subject equity_purchase): equity_agg_class_combination, equity_stock_requirement, equity_preferred_stock, all policy_scope; overwrite of 'may not take the holding above max_holding_usd' (tolerances). Dividend (equity_dividend_reinvested): equity_preferred_stock policy_scope; overwrite of the base dividend sentence (bracket, loyalty and relationship parts). Payment (equity_retirement_deferred: a partial redemption leaves a balance and returns the holding to active): equity_estate_retirement policy_scope and equity_preferred_stock gate redemption_notice_elapsed — anchor the written redemption request (equity_accounts.retirement_requested_date 2026-06-03), 30 calendar days, request date day 0, inclusive: 2026-07-02 (day 29) fails, 2026-07-03 (day 30) passes, frozen 2026-07-22 (day 49) passes; overwrite of 'It is paid at par, subject to board approval' (quarterly allowance). Request (equity_retirement_request): equity_estate_retirement and equity_preferred_stock, policy_scope; overwrite of 'a partial redemption must leave at least min_balance_after_partial_usd' (size-scaled minimum).

4. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. One Class H holding (issued 2013-04-09). The ceiling refund is dated as of the latest purchase (2026-05-18, 150,000.00). The dividend is the quarter 2026-04-01..2026-06-30 paid 2026-07-15. The payment concerns the latest approved preferred_redemption request (created 2026-06-03, 600,000.00); the 2023-08-14 redemption is history only. The request is written for the member's own holding.

5. FACTOR CARD (scratch evaluator = check_compute). Ceiling refund 7,500.00 (all-baseline 105,900.83): ceiling_counted_shares method multi-source — dividend within 4 months AND 9 entries -> purchases less retirements 1,030,000.00 (83,400.83); relationship 10,000.00 cross-difficulty farmland (17,500.00); tenure 5,000.00 (12,500.00); size 5,000.00 (12,500.00); operating 2,500.00 cross-difficulty operating, commitment 350,000.00 below 500,000 (10,000.00). Dividend 12,136.18 (11,638.53): basis method — latest purchase and the cancellation both dated 2026-05-18 inside the quarter -> 1,024,801.93 (13,007.77); bracket 4.50 (11,497.44); loyalty 0.10 multi-source (11,880.68); relationship 0.15 cross-difficulty (11,752.93). Payment 527,327.95 (274,600.21): allowance base method — dividend inside Q3, no retirement -> 1,110,537.01 (523,080.29); tenure 10 points (416,274.25); reinvestment 5 points (471,801.10); installment 18,640.00 cross-difficulty farmland, equipment 34,118.27 due 2026-08-20 is the near-miss (508,687.95); size reduction 5 points (582,854.80); delay addition 120,000.00 for 49 days (407,327.95); the 600,000.00 named exceeds the allowance, so the allowance is paid. Request 360,128.03 (179,006.67): purchase seasoning 6 months (132,751.97); dividend seasoning 3 months (351,685.76); minimum 15 percent of start-of-quarter shares 1,098,400.83 = 164,760.12 (362,751.97); combination method — unseasoned 162,136.18 below the minimum -> present less minimum (197,991.85); pacing reserve 10 percent for the redemption paid today (418,448.94). No stamp decides a tier: recent reinvestment and redemptions are counted from the ledger.

6. SEED. Customer; Class B 1,000.00; Class H 1,105,900.83 (purchases 1,080,000.00, nine reinvested dividends 75,900.83 regenerated with the dividend rule, 2023 redemption 50,000.00), status retirement_requested since 2026-06-03, direct deposit 5306; approved request 600,000.00; farm real estate loan (412,380.55, 18,640.00 due 2026-09-01); operating line (350,000.00); equipment loan (34,118.27 due 2026-08-20). Each purchase is within the 250,000.00 quarterly limit; the 2026-05-18 purchase alone breaches the ceiling. Removing the request removes the payment problem; removing the farm loan (re-running the gold chain with the farm real estate loan deleted) moves three factors to another tier (ceiling_relationship_tolerance 10,000.00 -> 0, dividend_relationship_premium 0.15 -> 0, redemption_installment_addition 18,640.00 -> the equipment installment 34,118.27) and changes every scored figure downstream: refund 7,500.00 -> 17,500.00, dividend 12,136.18 -> 11,697.48, payment 527,327.95 -> 539,152.68, request 360,128.03 -> 341,590.94.

7. PERSONA. Wendell volunteers only the goal (redeem the most allowed, keep the account open) and that he signs the request himself; credentials on request (7854651873, CPF-5274409, 8461, email, 2009-02-17); payouts to checking ending 5306 on request; the June letter for six hundred thousand dollars only if asked; passive acceptance of bookings and payments; submits the request for the quoted amount and closes.

8. STANDARD SOLUTION / GOLD. find_customers -> verify -> find_equity_accounts -> find_equity_transactions(customer) -> find_equity_requests -> find_farmland_loans -> find_operating_lines -> find_equipment_loans -> refund 7,500.00 as of 2026-05-18 -> dividend 12,136.18 payment date 2026-07-15 -> payment 527,327.95 -> member request 360,128.03. Gates per task and difficulty-wide: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

9. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. With only the four policies' prose, the docstrings, the find_* returns and the persona, the chain and every figure in section 5 are reproduced. Likely mistakes: counting dividend shares toward the ceiling, booking the dividend before the refund (12,179.13), paying the full 600,000.00, using the equipment installment, forgetting the delay addition, computing the request before the payment, or skipping the pacing reserve.

10. REVISION RECORD (round 2, policy-task audit). T1-R1: symptom — edge_load_bearing for request -> payment said skipping the payment leaves '1,098,036.83 more shares'; root cause — a misstated share delta; change — corrected to 527,327.95 more shares (1,110,537.01 instead of 583,209.06), re-verified by replaying the gold chain with the payment skipped; the 945,776.89 figure was already right. T1-R2: symptom — section 6 said removing the farm loan 'changes four factors'; root cause — an unverified count; change — replaced by the re-run result (three tier changes and the four downstream figures listed in section 6). No policy, tool, seed row, gold argument or scored value changed; equity.extended.yaml and task_tools.py are byte-identical to round 1. Every other numeric claim in this file and in the solvability contract, tracing and computations was re-checked against a replay of the gold chain.
user_scenario:
You are Wendell Pokorny, sixty-seven, who has raised corn and fed cattle near St. Paul, Nebraska since the early eighties. You are calling Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit on Wednesday morning, July 22, 2026, from the pickup, in no particular hurry and in plain words. A neighbor has offered you his quarter section and you want to free up cash toward the down payment. What you want today is to put in a request to redeem as much of your Class H preferred stock as the association's rules allow while keeping the preferred account open; you do not want it closed, and you have no idea what that figure comes to, so you ask the agent to work it out from your records. You are fine with the agent taking care of whatever the association handles on its side, but the redemption request itself is yours to sign, so when the agent hands it to you, you submit it yourself for exactly the amount the agent tells you.

When asked who you are, you give your phone number, 7854651873. When the agent wants to verify you, you read off your member number, CPF-5274409, from the patronage notice on the dash; if one more detail is needed, the last four of your Social Security number are 8461. Only if asked for an email is it wendell.pokorny@gmail.com, and only if asked when you joined, it was February 17, 2009, so 2009-02-17. Any money the association pays you on the preferred stock goes to your checking account ending 5306; you confirm that if the agent asks where it should go.

You do not volunteer anything else about your preferred stock. Only if the agent asks whether you sent anything in earlier about it do you say yes, you mailed a signed letter in early June asking to redeem six hundred thousand dollars and figured it was being taken care of. If the agent explains that something on your preferred stock has to be booked or paid first, you say that is fine, go ahead, and you wait while it is done; if the agent tells you an amount that was paid or booked, you just say all right, you trust the record. If the agent quotes the amount you can ask to redeem, you do not argue it or offer a different number, and when the agent hands you the redemption request, you submit it for that amount and read back the request reference you are given if asked. Once the agent tells you the request is in, you thank them and hang up.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (request <- payment <- dividend <- ceiling refund) with no parallel prerequisites; each order is stated by the blocked policy's own sentence: the dividend 'is fixed only after the holding carries a cancellation entry for every share it held above the largest balance a member may hold', the payment 'is fixed only after the holding carries the reinvested dividend for every quarter whose dividend payment date has passed', and a new request 'is not registered until no approved redemption on the holding whose notice period has run remains unpaid'.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the payment leaves the holding retirement_requested with 527,327.95 more shares on it (1,110,537.01 instead of 583,209.06): the request evaluates to 945,776.89 instead of 360,128.03 and the 527,327.95 retirement entry is missing.
Skipping the dividend makes the allowance base the start-of-quarter shares: the payment evaluates to 523,080.29 instead of 527,327.95 (and the request to 203,028.36); the reinvested entry is missing.

Skipping the ceiling refund leaves the 7,500.00 excess on the holding: the dividend evaluates to 12,179.13 instead of 12,136.18, the payment to 529,967.99 and the request to 363,415.65; the cancellation entry is missing.
